Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - CC/805/2022

Dear Ms. Bhatt,

Thank you for meeting us on 21/09/2022 about your dispute with Varghese Textiles Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 34,80,000.

Regards,
Adv. Sharmila Venkatesan
